user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with the maximum allowed guests (10) so that boundary values are handled correctly.

positive.title: Create a booking with the maximum allowed guests
steps: Select the date and time for the booking.
Enter guest details and set the number of guests to 10.
positive.expected_result: Booking is successfully created with 10 guests.

negative.title: Fail to create a booking with more than maximum allowed guests
steps: Select the date and time for the booking.
Enter guest details and set the number of guests to 11.
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed: 'Number of guests cannot exceed 10.'

edge.title: Create a booking with no guests
steps: Select the date and time for the booking.
Enter guest details and set the number of guests to 0.
edge.expected_result: Error message is displayed: 'At least one guest is required for booking.'
